acceptanceCriteria: The stack-snapshot assertion in internal/contextindex/taskcontext_cancel_test.go no longer fails on a goroutine that has already closed its ready channel but not yet exited; `go test -count=200 -run TestTaskContextCancellationNeverReturnsAPacket ./internal/contextindex/` passes locally.
The product guarantee stays tested: no history or recency work runs after TaskContext returns, and a deliberately broken join still fails the test.
Record the hosted run id and the fix in the PR body; no spec change unless the test contract text in docs names the stack check.
body: Observed 2026-10-13 on hosted CI run 38476173623 (pull_request, PR beamfall/corvint#867 head 302f258fadd17989eebb12bdbb8aaeff34e15901, go-product-shard (7)), a PR that changes only .github/workflows/ci.yml, tools/ci-reuse-plan and docs. internal/contextindex TestTaskContextCancellationNeverReturnsAPacket/recency-on/lexical-term failed with `taskcontext_cancel_test.go:51: startContextRecency.func still running after TaskContext returned`; every other stage in both recency modes passed in the same run. Cause (inferred from source): recency.go startContextRecency runs `defer close(recency.ready); recency.read()` in a goroutine, and TaskContext's join awaits `ready`. The close happens inside the deferred call, so the goroutine's frame `startContextRecency.func1` can still appear in runtime.Stack for a few microseconds after await returns, although no further work runs. assertTaskContextReadersJoined takes one stack snapshot and fails on that transient frame. Expected: the assertion tolerates the goroutine's exit window (bounded poll of runtime.Stack, e.g. up to 100ms) or the reader signals completion as the goroutine's final statement in a way the test can observe deterministically; the product guarantee (no work after join) is unchanged. Actual: a false-positive FAIL costs a full go-product-shard rerun (~25 min) and blocks merge-queue throughput. Recovery used: `gh run rerun --failed`.
title: Flaky: TestTaskContextCancellationNeverReturnsAPacket sees startContextRecency.func after await returned
